interpretations: Group Examination records by non-null `ID`. For each group, divide its record count by the total count across all groups. Keep groups whose share is strictly greater than the average share across groups. Return one unrounded row containing the kept groups’ average record count, average share, and average share minus the average share across all groups.
queries:
WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count,
           COUNT(*) AS group_count
    FROM group_counts
)
SELECT AVG(g.record_count),
       AVG(1.0 * g.record_count / t.total_count),
       AVG(1.0 * g.record_count / t.total_count) - 1.0 / t.group_count
FROM group_counts AS g
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE 1.0 * g.record_count / t.total_count > 1.0 / t.group_count
